- A BCBA drive-time automation is being built that calculates drive times from each BCBA to the client and displays the BCBA name and duration. Two filters are required: (1) BCBAs must be from the same state as the client, and (2) BCBAs must have status 'Active Therapy' on the BCBA/staffing board. [CONFIRMED · fathom/59324337 @ 00:13:01]
- A BCBA portal is being built so BCBAs can log in any day or week to view their supervision data, replacing the need to wait for individual emails from Jill. [CONFIRMED · fathom/145405486 @ 00:00:00]
- A Calendly scheduling solution is under discussion; one proposed option involves creating a separate Google/calendar account (new IDs for Almira and Andrea) used only for BT interview bookings, keeping their existing Horizons email calendars for RBT and internal meetings, so Calendly availability correctly excludes only RBT/internal meeting blocks. [CONFIRMED · fathom/119849126 @ 00:15:47 – 00:16:40]
- A ClickUp task template was created for all projects covering stages: implement V1, testing, client demos, etc., with a Gantt chart view showing task dependencies; subtasks differ per project but the top-level task structure is standardized. [CONFIRMED · fathom/110840081 @ 00:10:41]
- A Google Calendar double-booking prevention automation was built for Kara/Tara; it detects duplicate bookings within a 30-day window and auto-cancels the duplicate, then sends a notification email.
